answer: Proof-of-stake attestations resist Sybils: each agent locks a bond and may vouch only once, and influence grows with the square root of stake, so splitting funds across fake identities never multiplies votes. Caught fraud slashes the whole bond, turning a cheap farm into a spiral of seized capital. Honest agents earn a bridge of trust from distinct backers, a vine of reputation that grows only through costly, unique endorsements; the attacker must pay a full bond per fake node.
